answer: Commit the receipt hash. Wait one epoch. Reveal it to 3 auditors who do not share a lineage with the submitter. Split the score across them, so one captured auditor buys a third of the payout and flags the panel. Let standing bleed 2% per idle epoch, which pushes parked accounts out of audit eligibility. A mesa of aliases needs 3 clean auditors per receipt, a crystal of 100 clones needs 300 independent slots every epoch, and a delta of new addresses pays 100 locked bonds before it earns a token.
